positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Modified existing embedded software to correct errors, added functionalities and improved performance using C, nRF5 SDK, and Segger Embedded Studio
• Designed, and implemented time synchronization among wearable medical sensor devices using Bluetooth low energy and applied to embedded C
• Improved Bluetooth communication protocol between iOS application and embedded sensor devices
• Used Nordic Power Profiler Kit and Saleae Logic Analyzer to optimize and verify the firmware
• Built automation program for programming embedded device and updating the device information into MySQL database
• Developed embedded testing codes for the client company and instructed client company’s technical team for installing
wireless firmware to the nRF52 Development Kit
• Built data streaming service between Embedded device and iOS application using C, C# and Bluetooth low Energy

positions.description: Provided feedback and guidance to students, graded papers and demos, and communicated with professors to improve the course.

positions.title: Sergeant, Squad Leader
positions.description: • Improved the relationship between soldiers, and supervised low-ranked Korean soldier for their career in Army by organizing weekly counseling schedule

projects.title: Deep Learning Project
projects.description:
•	Worked with a team of 3 to automatically describe the content of an image using properly formed English sentences using CNN, LSTM, Pytorch and python
•	Researched and investigated the deep learning algorithm for implementing the project successfully

projects.title: Microprocessor Project
projects.description:
•	Collaborated with a team of 3 to design and build a 5-stage pipelined microprocessor with certain advanced features including multi-stage zero-cycle forwarding, 2-level cache, and branch predictor using SystemVerilog with the Quartus II software
•	Successfully Designed, developed, debugged and evaluate codes for building better and faster microprocessor
